designationHistory.indexText: Mattamuskeet National Wildlife Refuge, located on the Albemarle-Pamlico Peninsula in Hyde County, North Carolina, was established in 1934.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
